gloss: root of future trouble; source of evil

definitions.gloss: root of future trouble; source of evil
definitions.explanation: Something left behind that will cause trouble later: an unsettled dispute, a bad decision, lingering resentment. A formal written word, used almost only in {禍根|かこん}を{残|のこ}す and {禍根|かこん}を{断|た}つ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: To leave the seeds of future trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should root out the cause of trouble while we can.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: The plan, decided without enough discussion, later left a legacy of serious trouble.

notes:
Made of {禍|か} (misfortune) + {根|こん} (root).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave the seeds of future trouble
- {禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧: to remove the root of trouble
- ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禍根|かこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}さない→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: so as not to cause trouble later

- ⟦{災|わざわ}い→災い：27851_wazawai⟧: disaster, misfortune
